framework.working_paper_title: Auditable Tests for Information from Future Random Events: A Causal, Cryptographic, and Anytime-Valid Protocol
framework.core_question: Can an exact witness frozen before target generation contain information about a later certified random target beyond the admitted forward-causal guessing bound?

soundness_theorem.name: Auditable Independent-Future Challenge Soundness Theorem
soundness_theorem.statement: With complete pre-target side information F, pre-target candidate sets C fixed before target generation, history-wise point-guess bounds, post-freeze certified target generation, causal-isolation evidence, external freshness, safe witness quorum, no postselection, and an anytime-valid e-process, the specified forward-causal null has type-I error bounded by alpha. A threshold crossing rejects that null-or-an-evidence-premise; it does not by itself establish a retrocausal mechanism.

prior_art_review.boundary: Targeted search only; absence of an exact match is not proof of global novelty.

candidate_delta: A single fail-closed operational evidence stack that composes the known components specifically to test pre-existing exact information about a certified post-freeze random target without assuming a retrocausal channel in advance.

requirements: broaden scholarly and patent prior-art search
freeze a protocol manuscript and threat model
implement one external public-beacon trial path independent of Genesis
publish null results as first-class outcomes
seek independent reproduction by a second implementation
